nodes.name: Daily Market Close Trigger
nodes.notes: Runs every weekday at 16:30 IST (= 11:00 UTC). Triggers the daily market data pipeline.

parameters.query: SELECT mr.trade_date, mr.regime_label, ROUND(mr.confidence_score::numeric, 4) AS confidence_score, mr.volatility_level, COUNT(DISTINCT ti.asset_id) AS assets_analyzed FROM market_regimes mr LEFT JOIN technical_indicators ti ON ti.trade_date = mr.trade_date WHERE mr.trade_date = (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM market_regimes) GROUP BY mr.trade_date, mr.regime_label, mr.confidence_score, mr.volatility_level LIMIT 1;

SELECT ma.ticker_symbol, ma.asset_name, ma.sector, mph.close_price, mph.volume, ti.rsi, ti.macd, ti.volatility, ti.daily_return, ROUND((ti.daily_return * 100)::numeric, 2) AS daily_return_pct FROM market_price_history mph JOIN market_assets ma ON ma.asset_id = mph.asset_id JOIN technical_indicators ti ON ti.asset_id = mph.asset_id AND ti.trade_date = mph.trade_date WHERE mph.trade_date = (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM market_price_history) ORDER BY ABS(ti.daily_return) DESC LIMIT 5;

nodes.name: RSI Alert Scan (Morning)
nodes.notes: Runs every weekday at 09:15 IST (= 03:45 UTC)

parameters.query: SELECT ma.ticker_symbol, ma.asset_name, ma.sector, ti.trade_date, ROUND(ti.rsi::numeric, 2) AS rsi, ROUND(ti.macd::numeric, 4) AS macd, ROUND((ti.daily_return * 100)::numeric, 2) AS daily_return_pct, ROUND(mph.close_price::numeric, 2) AS close_price, CASE WHEN ti.rsi < 30 THEN 'OVERSOLD' WHEN ti.rsi > 70 THEN 'OVERBOUGHT' ELSE 'NEUTRAL' END AS rsi_signal FROM technical_indicators ti JOIN market_assets ma ON ma.asset_id = ti.asset_id JOIN market_price_history mph ON mph.asset_id = ti.asset_id AND mph.trade_date = ti.trade_date WHERE ti.trade_date = (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM technical_indicators) AND (ti.rsi < 30 OR ti.rsi > 70) ORDER BY CASE WHEN ti.rsi < 30 THEN ti.rsi ELSE -ti.rsi END ASC LIMIT 20;

nodes.name: DB Health Check (8h)
nodes.notes: Runs every 8 hours to check database health

parameters.query: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM market_assets) AS total_assets, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM market_price_history) AS total_price_records, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM technical_indicators) AS total_indicator_records, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM market_regimes) AS total_regime_records, (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM market_price_history) AS latest_price_date, (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM technical_indicators) AS latest_indicator_date, (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM market_regimes) AS latest_regime_date, ((SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM market_price_history) >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '5 days') AS data_is_fresh;
